name: update_topic
description:
Update an existing Google Cloud Managed service for Apache Kafka topic.

**Important Notes:**

*   The UpdateTopic request requires the name of the topic to be updated in the format `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}`.

configs.description: Optional. Configurations for the topic that are overridden from the cluster defaults. Note that this will replace the entire set of configs for the topic.

fieldsToClear.description: Optional. Fields to clear in the topic update.

name.description: Required. The name of the topic to update. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster_id}/topics/{topic_id}

partitionCount.description: Optional. The number of partitions this topic has.
